mn70:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kāsīsu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ.
mn70:2.1: Ahaṃ kho bhikkhave aññatr' eva rattibhojanā bhuñjāmi,
mn70:2.2: aññatra kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave rattibhojanā bhuñjamāno appābādhatañ-ca sañjānāmi appātaṅkatañ-ca lahuṭṭhānañ-ca balañ-ca phāsuvihārañ-ca.
mn70:2.3: Etha tumhe pi bhikkhave aññatr' eva rattibhojanā bhuñjatha,
mn70:2.4: aññatra kho pana bhikkhave tumhe pi rattibhojanā bhuñjamānā appābādhatañ-ca sañjānissatha appātaṅkatañ-ca lahuṭṭhānañ-ca balañ-ca phāsuvihārañcāti.
mn70:2.5: Evam-bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn70:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Kāsīsu anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Kīṭāgiri nāma Kāsīnaṃ nigamo tad-avasari.
mn70:3.2: Tatra sudaṃ Bhagavā Kīṭāgirismiṃ viharati Kāsīnaṃ nigame.
mn70:4.1: Tena kho pana samayena Assaji-Punabbasukā nāma bhikkhū Kīṭāgirismiṃ āvāsikā honti.
mn70:4.2: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Assaji-Punabbasukā bhikkhū ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Assaji-Punabbasuke bhikkhū etad-avocuṃ:
mn70:4.3: Bhagavā kho āvuso aññatr' eva rattibhojanā bhuñjati bhikkhusaṅgho ca,
mn70:4.4: aññatra kho pan' āvuso rattibhojanā bhuñjamānā appābādhatañ-ca sañjānanti appātaṅkatañ-ca lahuṭṭhānañ-ca balañ-ca phāsuvihārañ-ca;
mn70:4.5: etha tumhe pi āvuso aññatr' eva rattibhojanā bhuñjatha,
mn70:4.6: aññatra kho pan' āvuso tumhe pi rattibhojanā bhuñjamānā appābādhatañ-ca sañjānissatha appātaṅkatañ-ca lahuṭṭhānañ-ca balañ-ca phāsuvihārañcāti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn70:4.7: Evaṃ vutte Assaji-Punabbasukā bhikkhū te bhikkhū etad-avocuṃ:
mn70:4.8: Mayaṃ kho āvuso sāyañ-c' eva bhuñjāma pāto ca divā ca vikāle,
mn70:4.9: te mayaṃ sāyañ-c' eva bhuñjamānā pāto ca divā ca vikāle appābādhatañ-ca sañjānāma appātaṅkatañ-ca lahuṭṭhānañ-ca balañ-ca phāsuvihārañ-ca,
mn70:4.10: te mayaṃ kiṃ sandiṭṭhikaṃ hitvā kālikaṃ anudhāvissāma,
mn70:4.11: sāyañ-c' eva mayaṃ bhuñjissāma pāto ca divā ca vikāle ti.
mn70:5.1: Yato kho te bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu Assaji-Punabbasuke bhikkhū saññāpetuṃ atha yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantaṃ etad-avocuṃ:
mn70:5.2: Idha mayaṃ bhante yena Assaji-Punabbasukā bhikkhū ten' upasaṅkamimha, upasaṅkamitvā Assaji-Punabbasuke bhikkhū etad avocumha:
mn70:5.3: Bhagavā kho āvuso aññatr' eva rattibhojanā bhuñjati
mn70:5.7: Evaṃ vutte bhante Assaji-Punabbasukā bhikkhū amhe etad-avocuṃ:
mn70:5.8: Mayaṃ kho āvuso --pe-- divā ca vikāle
mn70:5.12: Yato kho mayaṃ bhante nāsakkhimha Assaji-Punabbasuke bhikkhū saññāpetuṃ atha mayaṃ etam-atthaṃ Bhagavato ārocemāti.
mn70:6.1: Atha kho Bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
mn70:6.2: Ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu mama vacanena Assaji-Punabbasuke bhikkhū āmantehi:
mn70:6.4: Evam-bhante ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato paṭissutvā yena Assaji-Punabbasukā bhikkhū ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Assaji-Punabbasuke bhikkhū etad-avoca:
mn70:6.6: Evamāvuso ti kho Assaji-Punabbasukā bhikkhū tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinne kho Assaji-Punabbasuke bhikkhū Bhagavā etadavoca:
mn70:6.7: Saccaṃ kira bhikkhave sambahulā bhikkhū tumhe upasaṅkamitvā etad-avocuṃ:
mn70:6.8: Bhagavā kho āvuso aññatr' eva rattibhojanā bhuñjati bhikkhusaṅgho ca,
mn70:6.9: aññatra kho pan' āvuso rattibhojanā bhuñjamānā appābādhatañ-ca sañjānanti appātaṅkatañ-ca lahuṭṭhānañ-ca balañ-ca phāsuvihārañ-ca;
mn70:6.10: etha tumhe pi āvuso aññatra rattibhojanā bhuñjatha,
mn70:6.11: aññatra kho pan' āvuso tumhe pi rattibhojanā bhuñjamānā appābādhatañ-ca sañjānissatha appātaṅkatañ-ca lahuṭṭhānañ-ca balañ ca phāsuvihārañ-cāti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn70:6.12: Evaṃ vutte kira bhikkhave tumhe te bhikkhū evaṃ avacuttha:
mn70:6.13: Mayaṃ kho āvuso sāyañ-c' eva bhuñjāma pāto ca divā ca vikāle,
mn70:6.14: te mayaṃ sāyañ-c' eva bhuñjamānā pāto ca divā ca vikāle appābādhatañ-ca sañjānāma appātaṅkatañ-ca lahuṭṭhānañca balañ-ca phāsuvihārañ-ca,
mn70:6.15: te mayaṃ kiṃ sandiṭṭhikaṃ hitvā kālikaṃ anudhāvissāma,
mn70:6.16: sāyañ-c' eva mayaṃ bhuñjissāma pāto ca divā ca vikāle ti. --
mn70:6.18: Kin-nu me tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha: Yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tassa akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantīti. --
mn70:7.1: Nanu me tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha: Idh' ekaccassa evarūpaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, idha pan' ekaccassa evarūpaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti; idh' ekaccassa evarūpaṃ dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, idha pan' ekaccassa evarūpaṃ dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti; idh' ekaccassa evarūpaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, idha pan' ekaccassa evarūpaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantīti. --
mn70:8.2: Mayā c' etaṃ bhikkhave aññātaṃ abhavissa adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ aphassitaṃ paññāya:
mn70:8.3: idh' ekaccassa evarūpaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantīti,
mn70:8.4: evamahaṃ ajānanto: evarūpaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ pajahathāti vadeyyaṃ, api nu me etaṃ bhikkhave patirūpaṃ abhavissāti. --

mn70:8.7: idh' ekaccassa evarūpaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantīti, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ tasmā 'haṃ: evarūpaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ pajahathāti vadāmi.

mn70:23.1: content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ Kathañ-ca bhikkhave anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā aññārādhanā hoti:
mn70:23.2: Idha bhikkhave saddhājāto upasaṅkamati, upasaṅkamanto payirupāsati, payirupāsanto sotaṃ odahati, ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti, sutvā dhammaṃ dhāreti, dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati, atthaṃ upaparikkhato dhammā nijjhānaṃ khamanti, dhammanijjhānakhantiyā sati chando jāyati, chandajāto ussahati, ussahitvā tuleti, tulayitvā padahati, pahitatto samāno kāyena c' eva paramaṃ saccaṃ sacchikaroti paññāya ca naṃ ativijjha passati.
mn70:24.1: Sā pi nāma bhikkhave saddhā nāhosi,
mn70:24.3: sā pi nāma bhikkhave payirupāsanā nāhosi,
mn70:24.6: sā pi nāma bhikkhave dhammadhāraṇā nāhosi,
mn70:24.7: sā pi nāma bhikkhave atthūpaparikkhā nāhosi,
mn70:24.8: sā pi nāma bhikkhave dhammanijjhānakhanti nāhosi,
mn70:24.9: so pi nāma bhikkhave chando nāhosi,
mn70:24.10: so pi nāma bhikkhave ussāho nāhosi,
mn70:24.11: sā pi nāma bhikkhave tulanā nāhosi,
mn70:24.14: Kīva dūre v' ime bhikkhave moghapurisā apakkantā imasmā dhammavinayā.
mn70:25.1: Atthi bhikkhave catuppadaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ yass' uddiṭṭhassa viññū puriso nacirass' eva paññāy' atthaṃ ājāneyya.
mn70:25.3: Ke ca mayaṃ bhante ke ca dhammassa aññātāro ti. --
mn70:26.1: Yo pi so bhikkhave satthā āmisagaru āmisadāyādo āmisehi saṃsaṭṭho viharati, tassa p' ayaṃ evarūpī paṇopaṇavidhā na upeti:
mn70:26.2: evañ-ca no assa atha naṃ kareyyāma, na ca no ev' assa na naṃ kareyyāmāti; kim-pana bhikkhave yaṃ Tathāgato sabbaso āmisehi visaṃsaṭṭho viharati.

mn70:27.6: kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhī ca avasissatu, sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yan-taṃ purisatthāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa santhānaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn70:27.7: Saddhassa bhikkhave sāvakassa satthu sāsane pariyogāya vattato dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
mn70:27.8: diṭṭhe va dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā ti.
